findings.reason: with the intra-plan edge absent the roadmap reads §7 as independent, so a coordinator may dispatch the hourly timer before §3's sweep predicate exists, which is the ordering the plan itself relies on.
findings.text: §7's mechanism runs the §3 sweep (plan.html:142) and the plan's followup states "§3 lands before §7, which calls it" (plan.html:165), but `plan-section-depends-on` (plan.html:22) records only s4 and s5, and encodes no s7 → s3 edge

findings.reason: read literally the gate directs an irreversible removal against the live crew home's event logs, which §1 treats as another plan's one-off reclaim, instead of against a fixture whose removal can be re-run.
findings.text: §4's done-when requires "the real run removes exactly that list, and `crew/watch/` holds under 1 MB afterwards" without scoping that run to a temporary crew home, where §3 and §7 both scope theirs

findings.reason: if the removal binds to an attempt's exit rather than the run's terminal exit it deletes `codex-home/cache/` and `codex-home/plugins/` out from under an attempt that is still running, which is the case the sentence claims cannot happen, so the node needs the caller pinned or a guard on the run's live state.
findings.text: §6 asserts "The removal runs where the exit is recorded, so a run that is still working is never touched", but that site is not named and a run directory carries one exit record per attempt (an observed run directory holds `attempt-1-exit.json` beside `attempt-2-worker.json` and `attempt-2.claim`)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `retention_days` in `reckon/crew/gc.py`, `reckon/crew/runs.py`, `RUN_HOME_SESSIONS` in `reckon/crew/rollout.py`, `_record_lease_node` and `_prune_must_keep` in `checkout_trust`, `mounts.json`, `reckon-paid-lanes.timer`, the monitor plan's §7 and §12, and the three linked docs all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §4's done-when (plan.html:105) measures a destructive sweep of the live `crew/watch/` tree and scopes no temporary crew home, unlike §3 (plan.html:92) and §7 (plan.html:149).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the sweep's own log is placed under the crew home and rotates by size, and every gate measures in a temporary crew home or a temporary runtime root rather than a session scratchpad or node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the prose carries only section references belonging to live plans, and no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol, filename, comment or docstring.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §6's claim that "a run that is still working is never touched" rests on an unnamed exit-recording site, while a run directory holds one exit record per attempt.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each of §2–§7 names one deliverable: pointer slimming, the retention predicate, event-log retirement, reload-cache relocation, harness-cache removal at exit, and the hourly cross-project sweep.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — `plan-section-depends-on` (plan.html:22) declares only s4 and s5 and omits the s7 → s3 edge the plan's own §7 and followup f-cssb-002 both depend on.
